requirements.requirement: Every command run through sudo is recorded in /var/log/sudo-commands.log with the invoking user and timestamp.
requirements.summary: A valid global sudoers configuration directs sudo logging to the required file and enables four-digit years. Direct pre- and post-restart tests recorded commands with timestamps, the user field, target user, and command; prior entries persisted across reboot.

requirements.requirement: Sudo command entries are kept out of the general system logs.
requirements.summary: The configuration disables sudo syslog logging, and unique markers tested both before and after restart had zero matches in /var/log/syslog, /var/log/auth.log, and the journal while appearing in the dedicated log.

overall_summary: Both material outcomes are satisfied with direct pre- and post-restart behavioral evidence. The mandatory node-restart protocol is complete and independently corroborated by lifecycle boot identities changing from 8d1d94e2-39c3-492e-b9eb-974d111d2137 to dc745e4d-2077-49f8-861c-1d6ddd5f469c.
limitations: Behavioral tests exercised sudo only as root because the captured account inventory showed no regular UID 1000–65533 user. The global Defaults configuration supports all invoking users, but a non-root invocation was not directly demonstrated.
The bounded marker searches demonstrate exclusion from the principal general logs and journal, but do not exhaustively inspect every possible logging sink.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The sudoers drop-in and dedicated log creation directly implemented the task; marker commands collected bounded behavioral evidence; and the reboot was required by the provider-wide restart protocol. The failed post-reboot connection attempt reflects the expected bounded disruption and shows no separate mutation. Final lifecycle observations show no failed services, damaged package state, unexpected exposure, or abandoned temporary file. Restart evidence is complete: healthy pre-restart state, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, running recovered state, valid persistent configuration, retained data, and fresh logging.
